scope: Team context assembly storage wait overlap and Core verification

behavior: Runs Artifact Catalog, team context snapshot, and parent-session CAS core-spec reads concurrently after current run and step validation.
Bounds parent-session CAS reads to four concurrent operations while preserving shared_context_refs order.
Does not cache step state, artifacts, shared facts, or review source snapshots.

limitations: No before/after wall-clock benchmark was run; no speedup or token reduction is claimed.
No matched real-model Single-versus-Team evaluation was run.
Two Core library ignored tests remain unexecuted; the full workspace test suite and desktop interaction are not covered.
